description.narrative: The project is expected to increase the capacity of the Company to improve access to quality mobile broadband for individuals and businesses in Armenia through the deployment of fiber and 4G+ infrastructure. A portion of the SLB proceeds will go towards refinancing of existing debt enabling the Company to free up cash flow that will be used to fund its annual CAPEX program. The project will support the integration of the capital market in Armenia via the issuance of the first SLB. The success of this transaction will demonstrate the viability of the SLB asset class that will support private companies to raise funds from various investors as well as improve their environmental impact through the achievement of sustainable targets linked to this financing method.

The proposed investment will support Telecom Armenia OJSC (Telecom Armenia or Company, https://www.telecomarmenia.am/en/about-us/), an existing IFC client, in issuance of a senior unsecured sustainability-linked bond (the SLB) in the amount of up to US$75 million, to be listed on the Armenia Stock Exchange. Telecom Armenia is the second largest mobile network operator (MNO) and internet service provider in Armenia. The Company operates under the brand name Team and is publicly listed on Armenia Stock Exchange since October 2023. The SLB proceeds are expected to be used to: (i) refinance the Companys current loans; (ii) finance the Companys investments in advanced technologies (such as 4G+ and Fiber to the Home) to meet the growing demand for faster data services, expand its coverage throughout Armenia, densify its network and improve customer service; and (iii) strengthen the Companys competitive position in the Armenian telecom market.
